'''Darth Ordrem''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He gathered a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Baros system/Legends|Baros system]] in order to launch an ambush against the Republic, but was [[Battle in the Baros system|killed]] in a preemptive Republic strike.
